note: INTERACTION: focused_leaf points at a leaf this same pass PRUNES (mount-shape). root(region) → d:1(pinned mount) → i:w:2(row)=[w:1,w:2]; focus = w:2; observed drops window 2 (closed) and adds window 3. Ordering inside sync is PRUNE-then-ADOPT: w:2 removed first (i:w:2 collapses → w:1 sole leaf under the mount), leaving the anchor 'w:2' dangling. window 3 homes to display 1, so adopt_newcomers works inside mount d:1; adopt's reachability screen rejects the dangling 'w:2' and falls back to the mount's lex-first reachable leaf w:1. w:1 now fills the mount's usable rect (full 1200x800) → WIDE → row. Result: i:w:3(row)=[w:1,w:3] under d:1. Proves prune/adopt ordering + adopt's stale-anchor fallback compose correctly inside a display mount — a newcomer is never lost when its intended anchor vanished in the same reconciliation.
